data.name: How_Title
data.value: No reports needed. The lake tells us itself.

data.name: How_Model_Text
data.value: Eawag lake models calculate up to four days ahead how warm it is at 0, 10, 20 and 30 m and where the thermocline lies.

data.name: How_Satellite_Text
data.value: Once or twice a week, satellite images show how clear the surface is and whether algae are spreading.

data.name: How_Weather_Text
data.value: Heavy rain makes inflows murky, wind stirs up the shore. Both go into the index.

data.name: How_Community_Text
data.value: Reporting the visibility after a dive improves the forecast. It is not required.

data.name: About_MetaDescription
data.value: How the dive forecast works, which data sources we use, legal notice and privacy policy of tauchplaetze.ch.

data.name: About_Lead
data.value: A non-commercial project by divers for everyone who dives in Swiss lakes and rivers. No ads and no tracking.

data.name: About_Forecast_Lead
data.value: No reports needed: the lake tells us itself. Twice a day a job fetches data from four sources and calculates the dive index for every site for five days.

data.name: About_Levels_Lead
data.value: Every site has a data level. It shows how close the data is to the site.

data.name: About_Level_3
data.value: Precise: temperature profile at the site from the Eawag 3D lake model.

data.name: About_Level_2
data.value: Water body: profile for the whole lake from the 1D model, for rivers a FOEN gauging station.

data.name: About_Level_1
data.value: Weather: only wind and rain at the site. An index exists only with a satellite image.

data.name: About_Index_Note
data.value: The dive index (0 to 10) is an indicator, not a guarantee of visibility. Check the conditions on site, and never dive alone.

data.name: About_Sources_Lead
data.value: We show all data with attribution. The pages read only our own database; only the job queries the sources.

data.name: About_Source_Alplakes_Text
data.value: Lake models (3D and 1D) with the temperature at depth, plus satellite data on clarity and algae. © Eawag.

data.name: About_Source_Weather_Text
data.value: Weather models ICON-CH1 and ICON-CH2 by MeteoSwiss (open government data) and ICON by DWD, retrieved via Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0).

data.name: About_Source_Hydro_Text
data.value: Discharge and water temperature of the measuring stations of the Federal Office for the Environment, fetched via existenz.ch, plus the discharge forecast directly from the FOEN. Open Government Data with attribution.

data.name: About_Source_Swisstopo_Text
data.value: National map, aerial imagery (SWISSIMAGE) and lake depth data (swissBATHY3D) for the depth contours. Open government data, © swisstopo.

data.name: About_Source_Osm_Text
data.value: Initial set of dive sites with name, location and some details. © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL). The data we took over is also available under the ODbL.

data.name: About_Imprint_Liability
data.value: All information without guarantee. The forecast is an indicator; diving is at your own risk. The operators of linked pages are responsible for their content.

data.name: About_Privacy_Lead
data.value: We process as little personal data as possible, in line with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).

data.name: About_Privacy_Visit_Text
data.value: You do not need an account to visit. We set no tracking or advertising cookies. For troubleshooting, the app writes operational data (requested address, time, errors) to a log, without IP address. We keep it for at most 30 days. If you choose a place on the start page, a functional cookie (tp_area) remembers only the place and the radius for one year, for example «zuerich:25». «Use my location» asks for your location only when you click it. The coordinate stays in your browser; only the nearest place from the list is sent.

data.name: About_Privacy_Hosting_Text
data.value: Website, database and photos are hosted by Microsoft Azure in the Switzerland North region. Cloudflare delivers pages and images and protects against attacks. In doing so, Cloudflare processes your IP address. Cloudflare is a company based in the USA; the data may therefore also be processed outside Switzerland.

data.name: About_Privacy_Account_Text
data.value: Only contributors need an account: e-mail address, display name and the password as a hash. Signing in uses a technically necessary cookie, forms use a cookie that protects against misuse, and the editing pages a cookie with the language of the page. We also store when you registered and last signed in, without IP address or device. Confirmation and password reset mails go only to you.

data.name: About_Privacy_Contributions_Text
data.value: Changes appear in the versions of a site, with your name only if you agree. We show photos with the photographer’s name. The public image sizes contain no GPS or camera data; the original stays private.

data.name: About_Privacy_Location_Text
data.value: «Near me» asks your browser for your location. The coordinate is only part of the search address and may therefore appear in the app’s log. We do not analyse it and do not store it in an account. Your browser loads map tiles directly from swisstopo (geo.admin.ch); swisstopo sees your IP address. Your browser remembers the choice of map or aerial image.

data.name: About_Privacy_Routes_Text
data.value: The links to Google Maps and Apple Maps only transmit the site’s coordinate when you click them.

data.name: About_Privacy_Rights_Text
data.value: Under «My data» you see all data about your account and can download it. Under «Delete account» you delete your account: private photos and all originals are deleted, versions remain without a name. Questions and requests without an account via the

data.name: About_Privacy_Contact_Text
data.value: Name, e-mail address and message go to the operator by e-mail and are not stored in the database. The form uses a technically necessary cookie that protects against misuse. Against spam, we count messages per IP address, only in memory and for at most one hour.

data.name: About_Factors_Lead
data.value: The dive index combines four parts. Each part gives 1 to 10 points. The weight tells how much it counts.

data.name: About_Factor_Wind_Sources
data.value: MeteoSwiss ICON-CH1 and ICON-CH2, DWD ICON (via Open-Meteo)

data.name: About_Clarity_Title
data.value: Clarity: how clear the water is near the shore

data.name: About_Clarity_Text
data.value: We estimate the visibility depth (Secchi depth) where people dive. First we use Sentinel-2 with 10 m pixels, {0} m from the shore, otherwise {1} m. Without this value we use Sentinel-3 from the middle of the lake. Near the shore the water is usually less clear, so only {2} % of it counts. An image counts fully for {3} days. After that it loses weight, and after {4} days it no longer counts. Many algae cost points. Rain and much water in the inflows since the image reduce the visibility by up to {5} %.

data.name: About_Cap_Text
data.value: Nice weather does not turn murky water into a top day. If the visibility near the shore is moderate ({0} to {1} m), the index is at most {2}. If it is poor (below {0} m), the index is at most {3}. Without a visibility value it is at most {4}.

data.name: About_Wind_Text
data.value: We take the strongest hour between {0}:00 and {1}:00. Up to {2} Beaufort gives full points, from {3} Beaufort there are none. On a lake, wind stirs up the shore and makes entry and exit harder.

data.name: About_Inflow_Text
data.value: Rain and floods carry mud into the lake. We count the rain of the last {0} hours. We add the discharge of the inflows compared with the usual discharge, the median of the last 30 days (at least {1} m³/s). For the next days we use the discharge forecast of the FOEN. An inflow counts fully up to {2} km from its mouth, then less, and from {3} km not at all. So a flood of the Ticino clouds Magadino, but not Brissago.

data.name: About_Stratification_Text
data.value: Lake models of the Eawag calculate the temperature at each depth: at the site with the 3D model, otherwise for the whole lake with Simstrat. From this we find the thermocline. Below it the water is often colder and clearer. Full points only come when the surface is good too (from {0} m visibility near the shore).

data.name: About_River_Text
data.value: A river is mixed, so stratification does not count. We use the FOEN station of the site, with discharge, forecast and water temperature. Much water means a strong current. From {0} times the usual discharge we take off points, at {1} times {2} points.

data.name: About_Current_Text
data.value: The 3D lake model also calculates the current. We show the mean between {0} and {1} m depth as information. The current in a lake does not go into the index.

data.name: About_Updates_Text
data.value: The forecast runs daily at {0} for {1} days. We fetch the discharge every 30 minutes, the FOEN forecast from 08:15 every 3 hours. Satellite images come when the sky is clear: Sentinel-3 almost daily, Sentinel-2 about every 5 days.

data.name: About_Missing_Text
data.value: If a part is missing, we calculate with the others. Only clarity always counts: without a satellite value it counts carefully, and the index is at most {0}. Without wind or without water data there is no index, only an outlook with wind and rain.
